faqs.question: What is a landing page and how is it different from a homepage?
faqs.answer: A landing page is a standalone web page created specifically for a marketing or advertising campaign. Unlike a homepage with multiple links and distractions, a landing page has a single, focused call-to-action (CTA) designed to convert visitors.

faqs.question: Why is having a custom landing page so important for ads?
faqs.answer: Custom landing pages maintain message match with your ads, leading to higher relevancy, lower bounce rates, better Google Ads Quality Scores, lower cost-per-click, and substantially higher conversion rates.

faqs.question: How fast can you deliver a custom landing page?
faqs.answer: We can design and build a high-converting custom landing page in as little as 3 to 7 business days, including full responsiveness and analytics integration.

faqs.question: Do you help with A/B testing our landing pages?
faqs.answer: Yes! We set up A/B split tests on headlines, hero graphics, forms, and button placements to scientifically identify the highest-converting variations.

faqs.question: Can you integrate the landing page with our existing CRM and marketing tools?
faqs.answer: Yes, we integrate with all popular CRMs and marketing platforms including Salesforce, HubSpot, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, and Zapier.
